name: MonarchInvoiceView
title: InvoiceView
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of MonarchText, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchDescriptionList, MonarchMoney and androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider; printing through android.print.PrintManager with android.print.pdf.PrintedPdfDocument and a androidx.compose.ui.graphics.layer.GraphicsLayer capture
summary: A read-only invoice: issuer and billed party, number and dates, a status, line items, totals and notes, with an optional Print button.
whenToUse: To show an invoice that has been issued (sent, paid, overdue or cancelled), in a client portal or an invoice detail screen, and to print it or save it as a PDF.
whenNotToUse: To create or edit invoice lines, use a form the app builds. For a list of many invoices, use rows with MonarchMoney and MonarchStatusBadge. For a payment receipt, use MonarchReceiptPreview.
api: @Composable fun MonarchInvoiceView(items: List<MonarchInvoiceLineItem>, currencyCode: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, number: String? = null, status: MonarchStatusDefinition? = null, issueDateMillis: Long? = null, dueDateMillis: Long? = null, details: List<MonarchInvoiceDetail> = emptyList(), from: MonarchInvoiceParty? = null, to: MonarchInvoiceParty? = null, locale: Locale? = null, taxRate: BigDecimal? = null, discount: MonarchInvoiceDiscount? = null, totals: MonarchInvoiceTotals = MonarchInvoiceTotals(), notes: String? = null, footer: String? = null, showPrintButton: Boolean = false, onPrint: (() -> Unit)? = null, brand: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchInvoiceViewLabels = MonarchInvoiceViewLabels())
class MonarchInvoiceLineItem(id: String, description: String, quantity: BigDecimal, unitPrice: BigDecimal, detail: String? = null, amount: BigDecimal? = null)
class MonarchInvoiceParty(name: String, details: List<String> = emptyList())

class MonarchInvoiceTotals(subtotal: BigDecimal? = null, discount: BigDecimal? = null, tax: BigDecimal? = null, total: BigDecimal? = null, amountPaid: BigDecimal? = null, amountDue: BigDecimal? = null)
sealed interface MonarchInvoiceDiscount { class Percent(percent: BigDecimal); class Amount(amount: BigDecimal) }

class MonarchInvoiceViewLabels(title: String? = null, from: String? = null, to: String? = null, issueDate: String? = null, dueDate: String? = null, lineItems: String? = null, description: String? = null, quantity: String? = null, unitPrice: String? = null, amount: String? = null, subtotal: String? = null, discount: String? = null, tax: String? = null, taxWithRate: ((String) -> String)? = null, total: String? = null, amountPaid: String? = null, amountDue: String? = null, noItems: String? = null, notes: String? = null, print: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The billed lines, read-only. Empty shows "No line items.".

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the invoice.

options.name: title
options.description: The main heading. null uses "Invoice".

options.name: number
options.description: The invoice number, written after the title and so part of the heading TalkBack reads.

options.name: status
options.description: A status beside the title, drawn as a small MonarchStatusBadge.

options.name: issueDateMillis
options.description: The issue date in epoch milliseconds (UTC), written as a medium date in the locale.

options.name: dueDateMillis
options.description: The due date in epoch milliseconds (UTC).

options.name: details
options.description: More facts after the dates: payment terms, purchase order, project.

options.name: from
options.description: Who issues the invoice, under the heading "From".

options.name: to
options.description: Who is billed, under the heading "Bill to".

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts, quantities and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: taxRate
options.description: The tax rate in percent, used to work out tax when totals has none; the tax label then shows the rate.

options.name: discount
options.description: A percent or amount discount used to work out the totals when totals has none.

options.name: totals
options.description: The totals from the billing system; a given value wins over the worked-out one.

options.name: notes
options.description: Payment instructions or terms under the totals, with the heading "Notes".

options.name: footer
options.description: Small print at the bottom, in the caption style.

options.name: showPrintButton
options.description: Shows a small secondary Print button in the header.

options.name: onPrint
options.description: Replaces the built-in printing, for example to print the app's own PDF.

options.name: brand
options.description: A logo or wordmark at the top. The app gives it a content description, or null when decorative.

options.name: actions
options.description: More header actions after Print, such as Download PDF or Send. Left out of the printed copy.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, for example in the invoice's own language.

states.name: compact
states.description: Below 640dp each line is a block: the description and amount on the first row, "Qty 2 · Unit price $400.00" under it. Parties and facts are stacked.

states.name: wide
states.description: From 640dp the lines are a table with Description, Qty, Unit price and Amount columns, and the parties and facts sit side by side.

states.name: empty
states.description: No lines: "No line items." in the muted color replaces the lines; the totals show zero.

states.name: discount
states.description: The discount row, with a decorative minus sign, shows only when the discount is not zero.

states.name: tax
states.description: The tax row shows when a tax amount or a tax rate is given; with a worked-out tax its label carries the rate, "Tax (10%)".

states.name: paid and due
states.description: Amount paid and Amount due rows show only when given in totals.

states.name: printing
states.description: The Print button is disabled while the off-screen copy is captured; the system print dialog then opens.

appearance: Text in the default and muted text colors on the surrounding surface, with subtle dividers between lines and a default border rule over the total, which is in the heading style. The status badge carries its tone colors. It works the same in light, dark and both high-contrast themes; the printed copy is always in the light theme.
platformNotes: The web InvoiceView is an article with a real table, print styles and ReactNode slots, and takes decimal or minor-unit amounts. On Android amounts are BigDecimal in major units, dates are epoch milliseconds (UTC) formatted with android.icu.text.DateFormat, the status is a MonarchStatusDefinition, and the brand and actions are slots. The parity map named LazyColumn sections; the invoice is a Column instead, so it can sit inside the screen's verticalScroll with other content and be captured whole for printing, as on iOS. A Compose layout cannot be printed directly, so the built-in Print composes a copy off screen in the light theme without the header actions, captures it with a GraphicsLayer and writes it as PDF pages through PrintManager and PrintedPdfDocument; the system dialog also saves a PDF. Pages are cut at the page height, so a line can be split across two pages, which the web print styles avoid. The headingLevel option has no Android equivalent; the title and section names are TalkBack headings. iOS ships the same MonarchInvoiceView.
accessibility: The title, with the number, is a heading; "From", "Bill to", "Line items" and "Notes" are headings.
Each line is one TalkBack element read as its description, detail and labelled figures: "Discovery workshop, Two sessions, Qty 2, Unit price $400.00, Amount $800.00".
The list of lines carries collection info, so TalkBack reads the number of lines; each line carries its row index.
The column headings of the wide table are hidden from TalkBack because every line reads its own labels.
Each total row is read as its label and amount; the discount minus sign is hidden and the "Discount" label carries the meaning.
The Print button keeps a 48dp touch target.
Text wraps and grows at font scale 2.0; no row has a fixed height.
Right to left, labels and amounts mirror.
edgeCases: A total given in totals wins over the worked-out one even when they disagree; the view never corrects the billing system.
Line amounts are rounded half away from zero to the currency's digits (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3).
A discount larger than the subtotal is capped at the subtotal; a percent above 100 counts as 100.
Built-in printing needs an Activity context; elsewhere the button does nothing, so pass onPrint.
A very long invoice makes a tall bitmap while printing; the app can pass onPrint and print its own PDF instead.

examples.title: Issued invoice, totals worked out
examples.template:
MonarchInvoiceView(
    items = listOf(
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem({{items.0.id}}, {{items.0.description}}, BigDecimal({{items.0.quantity}}), BigDecimal({{items.0.unitPrice}}), detail = {{items.0.detail}}),
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem({{items.1.id}}, {{items.1.description}}, BigDecimal({{items.1.quantity}}), BigDecimal({{items.1.unitPrice}})),
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem({{items.2.id}}, {{items.2.description}}, BigDecimal({{items.2.quantity}}), BigDecimal({{items.2.unitPrice}}), detail = {{items.2.detail}}),
    ),
    currencyCode = {{currency}},
    number = {{number}},
    status = MonarchStatusDefinition({{status.label}}, {{status.tone|tone}}),
    issueDateMillis = {{issueDate|millis}},
    dueDateMillis = {{dueDate|millis}},
    details = listOf(MonarchInvoiceDetail({{detail.label}}, {{detail.value}})),
    from = MonarchInvoiceParty({{from.name}}, listOf({{from.details.0}}, {{from.details.1}})),
    to = MonarchInvoiceParty({{to.name}}, listOf({{to.details.0}})),
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    dateLocale = Locale.UK,
    taxRate = BigDecimal({{taxRate}}),
    notes = {{notes}},
    showPrintButton = true,
)
examples.code:
MonarchInvoiceView(
    items = listOf(
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem("1", "Discovery workshop", BigDecimal(2), BigDecimal(400), detail = "Two sessions"),
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem("2", "Design system setup", BigDecimal(1), BigDecimal(1200)),
                MonarchInvoiceLineItem("3", "Support hours", BigDecimal(6.5), BigDecimal(80), detail = "Billed hourly"),
    ),
    currencyCode = "USD",
    number = "INV-0042",
    status = MonarchStatusDefinition("Sent", MonarchTone.Info),
    issueDateMillis = 1_780_272_000_000L,
    dueDateMillis = 1_781_481_600_000L,
    details = listOf(MonarchInvoiceDetail("Payment terms", "Net 14")),
    from = MonarchInvoiceParty("Studio A", listOf("Street address", "City, postcode")),
    to = MonarchInvoiceParty("Client B", listOf("accounts@example.com")),
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US"),
    dateLocale = Locale.UK,
    taxRate = BigDecimal(10),
    notes = "Pay by bank transfer to the account on file.",
    showPrintButton = true,
)

examples.title: Totals from the billing system, printed by the app
examples.code:
MonarchInvoiceView(
    items = listOf(MonarchInvoiceLineItem("1", "Annual plan", BigDecimal.ONE, BigDecimal("800.00"))),
    currencyCode = "EUR",
    totals = MonarchInvoiceTotals(
        tax = BigDecimal("168.00"),
        total = BigDecimal("968.00"),
        amountPaid = BigDecimal("500.00"),
        amountDue = BigDecimal("468.00"),
    ),
    showPrintButton = true,
    onPrint = { /* The app prints its own PDF here. */ },
)
